_readme: Rights register for supplied artwork (files in media-pending/, never edited). status: pending | licensed | original. 'licensed' needs `permission` = where the written commercial-use permission is filed (e.g. 'Take-Two licence ref ..., 2026-12-01, legal/permissions/x.pdf'). 'original' is only for artwork the store owner created or commissioned with full rights, with `thirdPartyMarks` confirmed as [] and `permission` = the owner's statement. Official Rockstar material can only be 'licensed'. Run `npm run media:package` after any change.
